description: SDG 7.1.1 Access to Electricity: A spatially scalable global dataset from satellite nighttime lights (1992–2022), published by Liu, Luling; Cao, Xin, derives global functional electricity-access indicators from calibrated nighttime lights and gridded population. Coverage: Annual 1992-2022 indicators: 0.1-degree access rasters, country aggregates and 30-arc-second accessed-population density, within the documented 75 N to 65 S bounds. The repository supplies a public deposit and file listing. Only metadata was read; the files, schemas and calculations were not executed or checked. The deposit is marked cc-by-4.0. Its public landing page and listed open files are available without a login; upstream source conditions may also apply. Limitations: Functional access inferred from nighttime luminosity differs from nominal grid connection and survey access. The provider reports validation, which was not reproduced here. For catalogue screening, its documented functions support resilience, hazard exposure studies; this is an assessment of possible use, not a claim of validated performance. Related records: data-nasa-black-marble-night-lights covers the upstream radiance products, not this derived electricity-access or reliability layer.
